component-metadata.description:
Comparison of different normalization methods on data of your selection. The metanode generates set of figures selected that should be than inspected manually and optimal normalization technique selected a applied on the data outise the metanode. The figures are written into the __outputs__/figures subfolder in the KNIME workflow and you can select two more subfolders level in the metanode form.
You need to specify what samples to test the normalization method(s) on first - for this you need to run the Sample name extraction metanode to get a list of samples from which you can choose in this metanode. It is also possible to visualize only a subset(s) of the data, e. g. only replicates of a given sample, and their combination.
Normalization method to test can be selected globally or you can specify it independently for individual data for which the norm. methods should be tested.
Data to be processed using different normalization methods can be selected specifying their common prefix, suffix, name to be used in the graphs subtitles and name used in the exported figures filenames. Optionally, you can select also list of norm. methods if it differs from the global selection.
Please inspect individual parameters comments for more detailed help on them.
Within the metanode (access it e.g. by double clicking on the metanode while holding the Ctrl key), it is also possible to change certain plot parameters for all types of plots. The metanode needs to be disconnected before changing these parameters (right click on the metanode and select "Disconnect Link" in the Component menu).
The main purpose of this metanode is to assist with the automated generation of figures used for the different normalization approaches quality control and selection of an appropriate normalization method. The selected normalization approach should be selected in the Data normalization metanode.
